tickets.title: Unable to update billing email on invoice portal
tickets.issue_description: Customer cannot update the billing email address tied to invoices after changing their company contact.
tickets.previous_communication: Asked for a screenshot of the billing tab but none was provided.
tickets.drafted_response: Thanks for flagging this. I can help you update the billing email address and confirm the change in the billing profile.

suggested_internal_action.description: Ask the customer to confirm the account email and billing contact before changing records.

tickets.title: SSO login fails after password reset
tickets.issue_description: User is unable to sign in with SSO after resetting the password and receiving a verification email.
tickets.previous_communication: Customer mentioned the issue affects two team members.
tickets.drafted_response: I’m reviewing the login issue and will share the next support steps shortly.

suggested_internal_action.description: Investigate recent password reset flow changes for SSO compatibility.

tickets.title: Dashboard widgets are not loading after update
tickets.issue_description: A key dashboard widget remains blank after the latest product update and only affects the analytics view.
tickets.previous_communication: Customer reports the issue started after deploying the new dashboard theme.
tickets.drafted_response: Thanks for the details. We have escalated this to the dashboard team and will follow up with a fix update.

suggested_internal_action.description: Gather browser console logs and widget configuration details for diagnosis.

tickets.title: API rate limit errors for webhook retries
tickets.issue_description: Customer is seeing intermittent 429 API responses while retrying failed webhook deliveries.
tickets.previous_communication: Customer mentioned they are on the usage-based tier and need a retry window extension.
tickets.drafted_response: I’ve prepared a response explaining the rate limit behavior and recommended retry adjustments.

suggested_internal_action.description: Verify whether the customer is eligible for temporary retry allowance under the current plan.

tickets.title: Invoice download returns empty PDF
tickets.issue_description: Customer reports that the invoice download link produces a blank PDF when opened in the browser.
tickets.drafted_response: Thanks for reporting this. We confirmed the invoice export issue and shared the workaround.

suggested_internal_action.description: Confirm the issue is resolved with the provided browser workaround and archive the ticket.

knowledgeBaseArticles.title: Billing contact update guide
knowledgeBaseArticles.content: Customers can update billing contact details from the billing settings page. If the change does not appear immediately, verify the account email and ensure the contact change is saved.

knowledgeBaseArticles.title: SSO troubleshooting steps
knowledgeBaseArticles.content: If SSO fails after a password reset, confirm the identity provider is reachable, verify the browser cookie policy, and retry from an incognito window.

knowledgeBaseArticles.title: Dashboard widget troubleshooting
knowledgeBaseArticles.content: Blank widgets are often caused by stale browser cache or incompatible browser extensions. Check the browser console and verify the widget configuration.

knowledgeBaseArticles.title: Invoice portal FAQ
knowledgeBaseArticles.content: Invoices can be viewed, downloaded, and shared from the invoice portal. If a generated PDF is blank, try a different browser or clear cached content.

knowledgeBaseArticles.title: API rate limit policy
knowledgeBaseArticles.content: Most API usage tiers include a default request quota. A 429 response indicates that the retry window is temporarily exceeded; reduce concurrency or retry later.
